4681-5170-7918-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1742-1978-3363-3918.easyPrerequisites:
You have {1} available, a burden counter on Trazyn or an additional card in hand.
Trazyn doesn't have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using The One Ring's ability by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Trazyn
Repeat
1742-1978-3363-3918.notes: For the first loop, in step 2, you can either discard an additional card for {B} or provide {1} if Trazyn starts without a burden counter on it. On subsequent loops, this won't be an issue.

579-4824-6006.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2178-2380-6495.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-6495.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2178-2380-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4419-4694-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
4419-4694-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4694-5315-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5315-5805-7306.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1309-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1309-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
1309-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Salvager of Secrets and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1981-2415-3967-6772.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

824-997-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-997-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-997-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3257-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2034-2073-2921-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2073-5147-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4050-5086-5183-7743-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-7743-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

1895-4399-4770-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2033-4460-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-4460-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-4460-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

413-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Stickytongue Sentinel trigger, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
413-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

628-5147-7194.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1170-1177-3110-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

549-1978-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
549-1978-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat

654-4693-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-4693-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

567-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
567-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

5329-5399-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Pirated Copy on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Pirated Copy do not have summoning sickness.
5329-5399-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Pirated Copy.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Pirated Copy.
Activate Pirated Copy by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Pirated Copy ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

1744-2557-3487-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers ten times, causing you to get 110 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get eleven {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

703-3129-5257.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Riku of Two Reflections' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Primal Vigor that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Riku of Two Reflections' second ability trigger, causing you to pay {G}{U} to create a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Primal Vigor tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

2034-3079-3860-4999.notablePrerequisites:
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
Overwhelming Splendor attached to you.
2034-3079-3860-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Overwhelming Splendor removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1558-2963-4744-4840.description:
Activate Saheeli's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Servo, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1383-1742-2336.notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
1383-1742-2336.description:
Activate Oath of Lim-Dûl by paying {B}{B}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2743-3024-3280.description:
Cast Complete the Circuit by paying {5}{U}, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Complete the Circuit triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Croaking Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary that are 1/1 Frogs.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1409-1810-2690-4208-4893.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Deadeye Navigator.
The Deadeye Navigator token enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability, pairing it and Ixidron.
Activate Ixidron by paying {U}, blinking it.
All other nontoken creatures you control are turned face-down as Ixidron enters the battlefield.
Ixidron enters the battlefield, triggering the token Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Ixidron and the token Deadeye Navigator.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {1}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

890-4068-4659-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Nim Deathmantle attached to Palladium Myr.
You control a Mountain.
890-4068-4659-5003.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Palladium Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Palladium Myr dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Palladium Myr from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2269-3035-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: Nadier has a power of at least four.
2269-3035-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nadier, adding {G}.
Nadier dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Nadier on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Elf Warrior tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Nadier from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elf Warrior token, adding one mana of any color.
The Elf Warrior dies, triggering Nadier, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

818-2757-3490-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You control at least one additional creature.
You are the monarch.
818-2757-3490-5147.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping any other creature you control, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the tapped creature, targeting Jared and putting a +1/+1 counter on Jared.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2464-4222-4723.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Night Market Lookout.
Night Market Lookout does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters on it.
2464-4222-4723.description:
Activate Night Market Lookout by tapping it, adding {U}.
Night Market Lookout triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Night Market Lookout.
Repeat.

618-813-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages with haste.
The token copy of Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation and any second instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
